newsitem.title: USA: Material Sciences sees FY97 net below consensus.
newsitem.headline: Material Sciences sees FY97 net below consensus.

text.p: Material Sciences Corp said Monday its preliminary adjusted fiscal 1997 earnings are $16.1 million or $1.03 a share, below the consensus of earnings estimates of $18.2 million or $1.17 a share.
Earlier, Material Sciences said accounting irregularities at one of its subsidiaries caused the company to overstate operating earnings starting in late fiscal 1995.
Preliminary results for fiscal 1997 ended February 28 are based on net sales of $278.0 million.
Material Sciences said the investigation of the accounting irregularities will delay the release of its results until the end of April.
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, the company previously reported earnings of $14.0 million or $0.90 a share.
The company also reported preliminary adjusted earnings for fiscal 1996 of $9.8 million or $0.63 a share, down from previously reported earnings for that year of $12.0 million or $0.78 a share.
The preliminary adjusted earnings for fiscal 1995 were $16.4 million or $1.07 a share, down from $16.7 million or $1.10 a share as previously reported.
Material Sciences makes specialty coated materials and services.
